claim: The portable arithmetic exactly reproduces the Windows v1.014 internal predictor launch at 0x40C84F plus the tested normal clear-air path for three controlled cases.

sources.observation: Original predictor machine code executed in Unicorn matched 58 portable-core samples with zero mismatch.

notes: Call-site analysis performed afterwards classified 0x40C84F/0x40CB00 as an internal predictor/simulation path. This evidence must not be represented as live-player launch parity. Live launch is 0x40AD1D.
